challenge.title: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

datasets.product: Illumination at the Moon's South Pole, 2023 to 2030
datasets.region: Within 2 degrees of lunar South Pole
datasets.limitation: A model for 2026, not observations newly collected in 2026 or live habitat telemetry.

datasets.measurement: Calibrated charged-particle energy deposition in lunar orbit

fields: SECONDS: spacecraft elapsed time from 2001-01-01 UTC
AMPL: pulse-height amplitude for detector signals D1-D6, in ADU
ENERGY: deposited energy for detectors D1-D6, in kilo-electron volts

datasets.limitation: Orbital instrument measurements behind detector materials are not direct readings inside a lunar surface habitat.
Orbital surface observations are not interior habitat temperature.
Event records and model analyses are research context, not lunar surface radiation forecasts.

datasets.training_data: Primarily LRO imagery and terrain, with GRAIL, Lunar Prospector and JAXA SELENE inputs
datasets.training_scale: Approximately 2 million image tiles; over 1 million high-resolution camera images at 1 m and nearly 964,000 multispectral images at 100 m
datasets.limitation: This is not a conversational chatbot and does not directly measure ice. It is a research model for image/geospatial analysis; outputs require scientific validation.
The archive schedule lists the planned public-release date. Check the archive for actual product availability; this is not a CRaTER or Diviner release.

datasets.product: ISS Environmental Control and Life Support System water recovery milestone
datasets.measurement: Up to 98% total water recovery demonstrated on the International Space Station after addition of the Brine Processor Assembly
datasets.limitation: ISS technology demonstration, not a lunar-base performance guarantee; TECNOVA's game resource changes are illustrative and are not calculated from this percentage.
